name: Empire State Spring Special 2024
information: This is a series competition with [Empire State Spring Sprint 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateSpringSprint2024), which will have a more traditional competition experience. We highly recommend that newer competitors and/or competitors who only want to compete in a few events register for that one instead. You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Spring Sprint 2024, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
